description: Use when a merchant is ready to apply with RetryHub and wants to carry what they already said in this chat into the application. Inputs are non-sensitive answers only: niche, monthly volume band, country or entity, current processor, and situation. Returns a short summary the merchant can paste into the application or the RetryHub Telegram bot, plus both links. Nothing is stored and the answers are not added to the links. Does not submit an application, approve an account, or quote fees. Do not send names, emails, card numbers, government IDs, or bank details.

country_or_entity.description: Country of the business entity, such as United States or Germany.

current_processor.description: Current or previous processor name, if the merchant mentioned one.

monthly_volume_band.description: Monthly card volume band in US dollars, mapped from what the merchant said. Use not_sure if unknown.

niche.description: Business niche, such as skincare subscriptions.

name: start_application_handoff
title: Start a RetryHub application
